card: This PR replaces Boost.Test with an in-tree C++ test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Boost.Test introduces external dependency overhead in depends and Guix, interferes with linters and IWYU, and requires platform-specific signal stack workarounds. Removing Boost's test framework has been an open goal across RFC #34666 and issue #8670. The PR preserves backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims so existing tests and in-flight pull requests do not suffer merge conflicts. Most of the 167 modified files are mechanical include changes generated by a scripted diff.
changed_since_previous: Rebased with minor adjustments, including a clang-tidy fix in miniminer_tests and dropping Guix and vcpkg Boost.Test workarounds; the framework architecture remains unchanged.

enables: Subsequent migration of unit test suites from BOOST_* compatibility shims to native CHECK and TEST_CASE macros.

evidence: Longstanding developer interest in replacing Boost.Test across open RFC #34666 and historical issue #8670.
Eliminates build and platform workarounds for Boost.Test bugs, such as #36045 ('test: avoid undersized Boost.Test signal stacks').
Author description: 'Replacing Boost.Test as a runner helps us simplify depends and guix as well as use IWYU and clang-tidy within the tests more effectively.'
problem: Boost.Test adds external dependency and build configuration overhead in depends and Guix, creates hurdles for tooling like IWYU and clang-tidy, and has required workarounds for library quirks such as undersized signal stacks. In addition, its multiple assertion macros handle operand value logging inconsistently, complicating test failure debugging.

risk.why: A flaw in the custom test framework could lead to false-positive test passes, broken test builds, or flaky CI failures across platforms, but production code is untouched.

scope_notes: Although touching 167 files, the vast majority of file edits are mechanical one-line header changes performed via scripted-diff. The primary review surface is the new ~1200-line test framework implementation in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and build system adjustments in depends and CMake.
summary: Replaces the Boost.Test library with an in-tree unit test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. The new runner uses expression decomposition to log operand values automatically on failed assertions, while providing backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims to prevent merge conflicts. Boost.Test is removed from depends, Guix, vcpkg, and CMake build configurations.
